summary: Invesco Commercial Real Estate Finance Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce monthly distributions declared on July 31, 2026, for each class of its common stock. Gross distributions are $0.1600 per share across Classes S, S-1, D, D-1, I, E, and F, with net amounts varying after stockholder servicing fees. The distributions are payable to holders of record as of July 31, 2026, on or about August 14, 2026, in cash or through the distribution reinvestment plan. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation.
